points.en: GATT was a multilateral treaty signed in 1947 to promote international trade by reducing tariffs and trade barriers.
points.hi: GATT was a multilateral treaty signed in 1947 to promote international trade by reducing tariffs and trade barriers.

points.en: It served as the primary framework for global trade regulation from 1948 until the establishment of the WTO in 1995.
points.hi: It served as the primary framework for global trade regulation from 1948 until the establishment of the WTO in 1995.

points.en: Key principle: Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) treatment, ensuring non-discrimination among trading partners.
points.hi: Key principle: Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) treatment, ensuring non-discrimination among trading partners.

points.en: Focus: Primarily dealt with trade in goods, not services or intellectual property.
points.hi: Focus: Primarily dealt with trade in goods, not services or intellectual property.

meaning.en: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
meaning.hi: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade

explanation.en: A precursor to the WTO aimed at liberalizing trade through successive rounds of negotiations.
explanation.hi: A precursor to the WTO aimed at liberalizing trade through successive rounds of negotiations.

question.en: When was GATT replaced by the WTO?
question.hi: When was GATT replaced by the WTO?

answer.en: GATT was replaced by the World Trade Organization (WTO) on January 1, 1995, following the Uruguay Round.
answer.hi: GATT was replaced by the World Trade Organization (WTO) on January 1, 1995, following the Uruguay Round.

misconception.en: GATT was a formal international organization.
misconception.hi: GATT was a formal international organization.

correction.en: GATT was a multilateral agreement, not an organization; the WTO is the formal organization.
correction.hi: GATT was a multilateral agreement, not an organization; the WTO is the formal organization.

fiveFacts.en: Uruguay Round (1986–1994) led to the creation of the WTO.
fiveFacts.hi: Uruguay Round (1986–1994) led to the creation of the WTO.

fiveFacts.en: Prohibited quantitative restrictions like import quotas.
fiveFacts.hi: Prohibited quantitative restrictions like import quotas.

threeTraps.en: Assuming GATT covered services (it only covered goods).
threeTraps.hi: Assuming GATT covered services (it only covered goods).

threeTraps.en: Confusing GATT with the Bretton Woods institutions (IMF/World Bank).
threeTraps.hi: Confusing GATT with the Bretton Woods institutions (IMF/World Bank).

threeTraps.en: Thinking GATT still exists as a standalone entity.
